text_ar:
و حَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ قَالَ وَقَرَأْتُهُ عَلَى نَصْرِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَامَ الشَّجَرَةِ قَالَ فَنَسُوهَا مِنْ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ
text_ar_search:
و حدثنيه محمد بن رافع حدثنا أبو أحمد قال وقرأته على نصر بن علي عن أبي أحمد حدثنا سفيان عن طارق بن عبد الرحمن عن سعيد بن المسيب عن أبيه
أنهم كانوا عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عام الشجرة قال فنسوها من العام المقبل
text_en:
It has been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Musayyab who said: My father was one of those who swore fealty to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) near the tree. When we passed that way next year intending to perform the Hajj, the place of the tree was hidden to us. If you could point out clearly, you would (certainly) be knowing better. 
It has also been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Musayyib who learnt from his father that they were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the year of the Tree (i. e. in the year of the fealty of God's pleasure sworn under the tree at Hudaibiya), but next year they forgot the spot of the tree.
text_id: Dan telah menceritakan kepadaku [Muhammad bin Rafi'] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abu Ahmad] dia berkata; dan saya telah membacanya di hadapan [Nashr bin Ali]; dari [Abu Ahmad] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sufyan] dari [Thariq bin Abdurrahman] dari [Sa'id bin Musayyab] dari [ayahnya], bahwa para sahabat berada di sisi Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam ketika peristiwa pembaiatan di bawah pohon." Dia berkata, "Ternyata pohon tersebut sudah tidak ada ketika ditahun depannya."
